profileCases.name: bounded coding
profileCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: coding
    allow: [read]

profileCases.name: bounded static group
profileCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: coding
    allow: ['group:fs']

profileCases.name: dynamic MCP bundle
profileCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: full
    allow: [bundle-mcp]

profileCases.name: overlong concrete MCP tool
profileCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: coding
    allow: [server_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789__tool_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789]

profileCases.name: coding exact consumer grant image
profileCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: coding
    allow: [image]

profileCases.name: coding exact consumer grant update_plan
profileCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: coding
    allow: [update_plan]

profileCases.name: coding exact consumer grant view_image
profileCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: coding
    allow: [view_image]

profileCases.name: coding exact consumer grant progress_card
profileCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1

  tools:

heartbeatCases.name: bounded heartbeat
heartbeatCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  heartbeat:
    every: 30m
    activeHours: { start: '09:00', end: '24:00', timezone: UTC }
    timeoutSeconds: 30

heartbeatCases.name: retired skipWhenBusy
heartbeatCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  heartbeat:
    every: 30m
    skipWhenBusy: true

extensionCases.name: exact OpenClaw extension
extensionCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: minimal
extensions:
  - id: issue-tools
    kind: plugin
    format: openclaw
    source: clawhub
    ref: '@acme/issue-tools'
    version: 2.3.4

extensionCases.name: floating OpenClaw extension
extensionCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: minimal
extensions:
  - id: issue-tools
    kind: plugin
    format: openclaw
    source: clawhub
    ref: '@acme/issue-tools'
    version: latest
